name: _grid.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_grid.scss — the .home-mosaic masonry container: JS-driven
//  height transition and per-breakpoint min-heights. Imported by
//  home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// height is set inline by JS (containerH). Transitioning it makes the about
// section below slide smoothly when a card expands / collapses on hover.
.home-mosaic {
  // Matches the card expansion curve — the wall below slides at the
  // same pace as the tile above it grows.
  transition: height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.9, 0.35, 1);
  transition: height 0.6s $ease-spring;
  // Mobile: skip height transition — triggers layout recalc each frame
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: none;
  }
  min-height: var(--space-9xl);

  @include layout-540() {
    min-height: var(--space-10xl);
  }
  @include layout-960() {
    min-height: var(--space-9xl);
  }
  @include layout-1440() {
    min-height: calc(var(--space-8xl) + var(--space-5xl));
  }
  @include layout-1920() {
    min-height: var(--space-8xl);
  }

  // WebGPU ring-sheen overlay — the rust/ring-sheen canvas fills the
  // container (JS sets the backing size to the container's device-px
  // box); instanced SDF rings replace every tile's two pseudo layers.
  &-ring-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // Live GPU sheen — the tile pseudo rings drop out; the canvas draws
  // them (grid-wide, one draw call).
  &:has(> .home-mosaic-ring-canvas:not(.is-fallback)) .home-mosaic-item::before,
  &:has(> .home-mosaic-ring-canvas:not(.is-fallback)) .home-mosaic-item::after {
    content: none;
  }
}
